title: Mir space station as seen from STS-63 Discovery
author: NASA/JSC
description: STS063-712-017 (6 Feb. 1995) --- Russia's Mir Space Station during rendezvous operations with the Space Shuttle Discovery.  Docked at the bottom of the Mir facility is a Soyuz spacecraft.  On the opposite end (almost cropped out of frame at top) is a Progress spacecraft.  Onboard the Space Shuttle Discovery were astronauts James D. Wetherbee, mission commander; Eileen M. Collins, pilot; Bernard A.
